_doc: Sects the player can join. Optional home_region (TRAV-004, a region id): where the sect lives; older saves are credited with having visited it. Alignment bounds are inclusive. min_realm is a realm id. cultivation_bonus multiplies qi gathering for members. Ranks are ascending; each rank has name and contribution (lifetime contribution needed; the first rank needs 0) plus optional (G-011): min_realm (realm id needed for the rank), min_stage (SECT-004, optional int, default 0: a stage index within min_realm that the disciple must also have reached; ignored without min_realm), trial (enemy id from enemies.json; promotion to that rank needs winning a sparring match against it, which never kills, robs or loots; not allowed on the first rank), stipend ({spirit_stones, items: {item_id: count}} paid at the end of each month while you hold the rank) and monthly_duty (contribution to earn each month; falling short withholds that month's stipend, never demotes; waived the month you are promoted). Promotion to a rank without a trial is automatic once its contribution and min_realm are met. robe_color (optional, hex) is the robe members wear on the world map. shop (optional, G-008c): contribution shop entries [{item_id, contribution (cost, >= 1), min_rank (rank index needed, default 0)}]; spending contribution never lowers rank (rank follows lifetime contribution). reputation (top level): standing with each sect, separate from alignment; start value, min/max range, leave_penalty (lost with a sect when you leave it), mission_rate (reputation per point of mission contribution with your own sect), tiers [{min, name, price_mult}] ascending by min (price_mult applies at merchants whose region place has that sect as 'faction'). Per-sect reputation: min_join (reputation needed to join) and deed_scale (a witnessed alignment change of D moves this sect's reputation by D * deed_scale; negative = the sect admires what others condemn). Effects can also change reputation directly with {"reputation": {sect_id: delta}}. lecture (SECT-005, optional per sect): the elder's monthly lecture {name, days (>= 1, time it takes), qi_days (>= 0, days of qi gathered at the hall's density), insight_chance (0..1, plus 0.005 per Comprehension point above 10), insights [dao insight ids from dao.json; the first not yet known may be glimpsed]}; once per calendar month per disciple (sect.lecture_month). factions (top level, LW-002, optional): sects as living factions (SectFactions). strength_base: a sect's strength is the sum over its living NPC members of strength_base ^ realm index (mortal 1, Qi Refining base, Foundation base^2...). recruit: each month each sect, with monthly_chance (0..1), takes in one rogue generated NPC who cultivates, is min_age_years..max_age_years old, is not the player's spouse or descendant, and whom the sect would accept (alignment, realm). clash (LW-002b): each month each righteous/demonic sect pair (sect `alignment` tags; neutral sects never clash) clashes with monthly_chance (0..1); the loser (chosen by relative strength) loses `casualties` (>= 1) living NPC members; a clash involving the player's sect sets the world flag sect_call_<sect id>, unlocking that sect's call mission.

sects.name: Azure Cloud Sect
sects.description: An orthodox sect on misty peaks. Values virtue, discipline and the protection of mortals.

sects.name: Blood Lotus Sect
sects.description: A feared demonic sect. Strength is the only law; the weak are resources.

sects.name: Myriad Treasure Pavilion
sects.description: A merchant sect that trades with anyone who pays. Rewards craftsmen generously.
